This project was stalled for over 10 years. It was initially developed by a local builder, but due to irregularities in handling slum rehabilitation—particularly issues around vacating residents and unpaid rent—the project faced serious disputes. Some of the original residents still live around the site, and the area continues to have local tensions. This is also one of the reasons nearby commercial outlets, like Pizza Hut, are no longer operational.

The original allottees under the slum rehab plan have still not received their designated homes, which poses potential risks for new buyers. Additionally, the building’s core design and structure were developed by the initial builder before being taken over by a larger real estate group, raising concerns about construction quality. This history is one reason many flats remain unsold.
